name: GoDaddy
description: Domains registered at GoDaddy through the GoDaddy Domains API: list domains and their status, expiry, lock and auto-renew, check availability and prices, get name suggestions, read and change DNS records, nameservers and WHOIS contacts, and renew a domain. Personal Access Token.
instructions:
## GoDaddy
This connector manages the domains of one GoDaddy account through the **GoDaddy Domains API v1** (`https://api.godaddy.com/v1/domains`): the list of domains with status, expiry, transfer lock and auto-renew, availability checks with prices, name suggestions, DNS records on GoDaddy's nameservers, the nameservers themselves, WHOIS contacts, and renewal. Registering (buying) new domains, transfers, forwarding and cancelling a domain are not part of this connector; do those at godaddy.com.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://developer.godaddy.com/personal-access-token with the GoDaddy account that owns the domains and select **Generate Token**.
2. Give it a name, an expiry (up to 1 year) and the scopes it needs: `domains.domain:read` for the read tools; add `domains.dns:update` to change DNS records, `domains.domain:update` for lock, auto-renew and renewal, `domains.nameserver:update` for nameservers and `domains.contact:update` for contacts. The **Domains & DNS** bundle selects all of them.
3. Copy the token (it is shown once) into `GODADDY_PAT` and run `godaddy_list_domains` to check it.

GoDaddy's older key and secret (`Authorization: sso-key KEY:SECRET`, from developer.godaddy.com/keys) still works on these v1 endpoints but GoDaddy is retiring it for the Domains API during 2026, so this connector uses the Personal Access Token.

**Who may use the API**: GoDaddy's documentation says domain management (list, DNS, contacts, renewals, lock) needs an account that holds at least one domain or a plan that grants management access, and that anything that costs money (renewal) needs a payment method on file or a funded Good as Gold balance. From 2024 GoDaddy limited the Management and DNS APIs to accounts with 10 or more domains or a Discount Domain Club plan (and the Availability API to 50 or more domains); the current documentation no longer states those thresholds, but an account refused with `403` and a code such as `ACCESS_DENIED` is still blocked by an eligibility rule, not by a wrong token.

**Workflow**
- Portfolio: `godaddy_list_domains` (filter by `statuses` or `status_groups`, add `includes=contacts,nameServers` for more detail), then `godaddy_get_domain` for one domain: status, `expires`, `renewAuto`, `locked`, `privacy`, `nameServers` and the four contacts. The transfer authorization code is removed from the answer; get it in the GoDaddy account when you really move a domain.
- Finding a name: `godaddy_check_availability` for one domain, `godaddy_check_availability_bulk` for up to 500 at once, `godaddy_suggest_domains` for alternatives from keywords, `godaddy_list_tlds` for the extensions GoDaddy sells. These only read; buy at godaddy.com.
- DNS: `godaddy_list_dns_records` shows the whole zone, `godaddy_get_dns_records` the records of one type and name. `godaddy_add_dns_records` appends records and keeps the existing ones (calling it twice adds duplicates). `godaddy_replace_dns_records` overwrites every record of one type and name with the list you give (the usual way to change an A record or a TXT value). `godaddy_delete_dns_records` removes every record of one type and name. Always read the records first and tell the user what will change.
- Settings: `godaddy_update_domain` sets the transfer lock, auto-renew or the nameservers. Changing the nameservers moves DNS away from GoDaddy: after that the DNS tools no longer manage the domain.
- Contacts: `godaddy_update_contacts` replaces the registrant (required) and optionally the admin, billing and tech contacts; read them first with `godaddy_get_domain` and send complete contacts. A new registrant name, organization or email can start a 60-day transfer lock (ICANN change of registrant) and a confirmation email. `godaddy_resend_registrant_verification` sends the ICANN registrant email verification again.
- Renewal: `godaddy_renew_domain` renews a domain for `period` years and **charges the account's payment method**. It is installed switched off; turn it on only if the agent should be able to spend money, and always confirm the domain, the years and the price with the user first.

**Reading the answers**
- Prices from the availability tools are in **micro units** of `currency`: `price` 12990000 with `currency` USD is 12.99 USD. Availability prices are indicative; `definitive: false` means the answer came from a cache, use `check_type=FULL` for a live registry check.
- Dates (`expires`, `createdAt`, `renewDeadline`) are ISO 8601 in UTC.
- DNS record `name` is relative to the domain: `@` is the domain itself, `www` is www.example.com. `ttl` is in seconds (600 to 86400 on GoDaddy DNS). `priority` is for MX and SRV, `service`, `protocol`, `port` and `weight` for SRV.
- Writes answer `200` or `204` with no body on success.

**Paging**: `godaddy_list_domains` returns at most `limit` domains (up to 1000); for the next page pass the last `domain` of the page as `marker`. `godaddy_list_dns_records` and `godaddy_get_dns_records` take `offset` and `limit`.

**Limits**: the API allows about 600 requests per credential in a window of roughly 23 minutes (`RateLimit-*` headers; GoDaddy may change it). On `429` wait for the reset before trying again.

**Errors**: `401` a wrong, revoked or expired token; `403` a missing scope or an account that does not meet GoDaddy's eligibility rules (read `code` in the body); `404` a domain that is not in this account or a type and name with no records; `409` or `422` a value GoDaddy refuses (for example a TTL under 600 or an invalid IP address), with the field in `fields`.
prerequisites: A GoDaddy account that holds domains, and a Personal Access Token from developer.godaddy.com with the Domains & DNS scopes you need.

GODADDY_PAT.label: Personal Access Token
GODADDY_PAT.help: developer.godaddy.com, Personal Access Token, Generate Token. Pick the Domains & DNS scopes (at least domains.domain:read). The token is shown only once and expires on the date you choose (at most one year).
GODADDY_PAT.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without Bearer and without spaces. The older key and secret pair (sso-key) is not used here.

verifyHints.401: GoDaddy refused the token. It may be mistyped, revoked or expired: generate a new Personal Access Token at developer.godaddy.com/personal-access-token.
verifyHints.403: The token works but GoDaddy refused the call: the token lacks the scope (domains.domain:read for reading), or the account does not meet GoDaddy's Domains API eligibility rules. The code in the answer tells which.
verifyHints.rate_limited: GoDaddy allows about 600 requests per credential in a window of roughly 23 minutes. Wait for the window to reset and try again.

tools.name: godaddy_list_domains
tools.description: List the domains of the GoDaddy account: domain, status, expires, renewAuto, locked, privacy, createdAt. Optionally with contacts and nameservers. Sorted by domain name; page with marker.

statuses.description: Only domains with these statuses, comma-separated, e.g. ACTIVE,EXPIRED,PENDING_TRANSFER,CANCELLED.

status_groups.description: Only domains in these status groups, comma-separated: INACTIVE, PRE_REGISTRATION, REDEMPTION, RENEWABLE, VERIFICATION_ICANN, VISIBLE.

includes.description: Extra detail per domain, comma-separated: contacts, nameServers.

modified_date.description: Only domains changed since this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to return (1-1000).

marker.description: Paging: the last domain name of the previous page; the list continues after it.

tools.name: godaddy_get_domain
tools.description: Details of one domain in the account: status, expires, renewAuto, renewDeadline, locked, privacy, nameServers, transferProtected and the registrant, admin, billing and tech contacts. The transfer authorization code is left out.

tools.name: godaddy_check_availability
tools.description: Check whether one domain can be registered and at what price. Returns available, price and currency (price in micro units: 12990000 = 12.99), period in years and definitive (false when the answer came from a cache).

domain.description: Full domain name including the extension, e.g. example.com.

check_type.description: FAST (default) may answer from a cache; FULL asks the registry live and is slower.

for_transfer.description: true to check whether the domain can be transferred in instead of registered.

tools.name: godaddy_check_availability_bulk
tools.description: Check up to 500 domain names in one call. Returns a domains array with available, price (micro units), currency and period for each name, and errors for names that could not be checked. Reads only.

domains.description: Full domain names including the extension, e.g. ["example.com", "example.net"].

check_type.description: FAST (default) may answer from a cache; FULL asks the registry live.

tools.name: godaddy_suggest_domains
tools.description: Suggest available domain names from a domain or keywords, e.g. when the wanted name is taken. Returns a list of domain names; check prices with godaddy_check_availability_bulk.

query.description: A domain name or keywords, e.g. sunrise bakery or sunrisebakery.com.

tlds.description: Only these extensions, comma-separated, e.g. com,net,de.

sources.description: Suggestion strategies, comma-separated: CC_TLD (country extensions), EXTENSION (other extensions), KEYWORD_SPIN (varied keywords), PREMIUM (premium names).

country.description: Two-letter country code as a regional hint, e.g. DE.

city.description: City name as a regional hint.

length_min.description: Minimum length of the name before the extension.

length_max.description: Maximum length of the name before the extension.

wait_ms.description: How long GoDaddy may collect suggestions, in milliseconds (default 1000).

tools.name: godaddy_list_tlds
tools.description: List the top-level domains (extensions) GoDaddy sells, with name and type (GENERIC or COUNTRY_CODE).

tools.name: godaddy_list_dns_records
tools.description: List every DNS record of a domain on GoDaddy's nameservers: type, name (@ for the domain itself), data, ttl, and priority, service, protocol, port, weight where they apply.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: godaddy_get_dns_records
tools.description: List the DNS records of one type and name, e.g. type TXT and name _dmarc, or type A and name @. Returns an empty list when there are none.

name.description: Record name relative to the domain: @ for the domain itself, www, _dmarc, mail, ...

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: godaddy_add_dns_records
tools.description: Add DNS records to a domain without touching the existing ones. Each call adds the records again, so check with godaddy_get_dns_records first to avoid duplicates.

name.description: @ for the domain itself, or a host such as www.

data.description: Value: an IP address for A and AAAA, a host name for CNAME, MX and NS, the text for TXT.

tools.name: godaddy_replace_dns_records
tools.description: Replace all DNS records of one type and name with the given list, e.g. set the A record of @ to a new IP or change a TXT value. Records of other types and names stay as they are.

name.description: Record name to replace: @ for the domain itself, www, _dmarc, ...

records.description: The new records for this type and name; every existing one is replaced.

data.description: Value: an IP address for A and AAAA, a host name for CNAME, MX and NS, the text for TXT.

tools.name: godaddy_delete_dns_records
tools.description: Delete every DNS record of one type and name from a domain, e.g. all TXT records named _acme-challenge. NS and SOA records cannot be deleted this way.

name.description: Record name to delete: @ for the domain itself, www, _acme-challenge, ...

tools.name: godaddy_update_domain
tools.description: Change settings of a domain: the transfer lock, auto-renew, or the nameservers. Only the fields you pass change. New nameservers move DNS away from GoDaddy.

locked.description: true locks the domain against transfers to another registrar, false unlocks it.

renew_auto.description: true renews the domain automatically before it expires (charged to the account), false turns that off.

name_servers.description: New nameserver host names, at least two, e.g. ["ns1.example-dns.com", "ns2.example-dns.com"]. GoDaddy's own are ns*.domaincontrol.com.

tools.name: godaddy_update_contacts
tools.description: Replace the WHOIS contacts of a domain. The registrant is required; admin, billing and tech are optional. Send complete contacts (read them with godaddy_get_domain first). A new registrant can trigger a confirmation email and a 60-day transfer lock.

contact_registrant.description: Registrant (owner): nameFirst, nameLast, email, phone (+49.7611234567), organization, jobTitle, addressMailing {address1, address2, city, state, postalCode, country (two letters)}.

contact_admin.description: Administrative contact, same fields as the registrant.

contact_billing.description: Billing contact, same fields as the registrant.

contact_tech.description: Technical contact, same fields as the registrant.

tools.name: godaddy_resend_registrant_verification
tools.description: Send the ICANN registrant email verification for a domain again, when the registrant did not receive or let expire the first one.

tools.name: godaddy_renew_domain
tools.description: Renew a domain for a number of years. This charges the account's payment method: confirm the domain, the years and the price with the user before calling. Do not retry on an unclear error; check expires with godaddy_get_domain instead.

period.description: Years to add (1-10, within the extension's maximum). Default: the period of the original purchase.
